summary: Full e2e validation of the new Manual Sales feature (POST/GET/DELETE /api/gestor/manual-sale + UI dialog in Gastor 'Gastos' tab). 18/18 backend tests pass and the UI happy-path/edge cases pass.
critical_code_review_comments: GestorPage.js is 3093 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting (tabs into sub-components, manual-sale dialog into its own component).
Manual sale list endpoint /api/gestor/manual-sales has no pagination beyond a single 'limit' query param — fine for now but will need cursor/skip if a gestor logs many sales per day.

Validation messages are duplicated as raw strings inside create_manual_sale (store/payment_method/period). Consider Enum/Literal types on the Pydantic model so FastAPI returns 422 with consistent shapes; current 400 + free-text detail works but couples FE to PT-BR strings.

Frontend amount field accepts '0' (non-empty) which enables the submit button; backend correctly rejects with 400, but FE could pre-validate to avoid the round-trip and show inline error before submit.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up their own TEST_-prefixed manual sales. Final check via API confirmed 0 manual sales remain. The startup-task one-time inserts use 'manual_morning_sale' flag (not 'manual_sale'), so they're correctly isolated from the new feature's list/delete endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Manual Sales feature is fully working. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_manual_sales_jan2026.py covers auth, validation, create/list/delete, sort order, explicit-date shift-hour, dashboard total integration, and protection against deleting non-manual orders. Frontend dialog tested via Playwright: button '+ Venda Manual' opens dialog in Gastos tab; comma->dot normalization works on amount; empty/0 are properly rejected; success toast appears and dialog closes; reopening shows 'Últimas vendas manuais' list with the entry formatted 'Runner · R$ 600.55 (credit · manha)'; trash icon deletes with confirmation. Two-flag design (manual_sale vs manual_morning_sale) keeps the startup one-time inserts safely isolated from the user-managed list/delete UI.
verified_flows: POST /api/gestor/manual-sale happy path (returns success + order_id + amount + store; persists order with manual_sale=true)
Dashboard month totals increase by the inserted amount and decrease after delete
All 4 validation rules return 400 with PT-BR messages (Loja inválida / Forma de pagamento inválida / Turno inválido / O valor deve ser maior que zero)
Missing auth returns 401; wrong auth returns 401
GET /api/gestor/manual-sales returns sorted-desc list with all required fields and no Mongo _id leakage
DELETE /api/gestor/manual-sale/{id} removes only manual_sale=true docs (404 for unknown / non-manual ids)
Explicit date='2026-05-15' with period='tarde' creates an order with timestamp on May 15 at the expected shift hour (14h Brazil / 17h UTC)
Frontend: '+ Venda Manual' button visible in Gastos tab header next to Exportar IR / Foto+IA / Manual
Frontend: dialog has Loja, Turno, Forma de Pagamento, Valor, Data, Descrição fields (all data-testid'd)
Frontend: amount accepts both '600,55' and '600.55' and normalizes to '600.55'
Frontend: submit disabled when amount is empty
Frontend: success toast 'Venda manual lançada: R$ 600.55' appears and dialog auto-closes
Frontend: reopening shows new entry in 'Últimas vendas manuais' as 'Runner · R$ 600.55 (credit · manha)'
Frontend: trash icon deletes the entry with toast 'Venda manual removida' and KPIs update
